Original seven-method run had five passes/two errors. v2 uses the authorized workspace Provider path and initializes both services before transaction gates; product and assertions unchanged.

Reviewer provenance lookup assumed the accepted M2-01 review was directly archived by M3. It is pinned by the archived M2-02 baseline. Failure occurred before any database open; v2 follows that verified hash chain without changing replay assertions.
